goal: Prove durable journal consistency under simulated mid-record torn writes, framing validation, and compaction crash replay.
hypothesis: Framed journal records with length headers and CRC32/SHA-256 checksums allow atomic recovery of valid prefix while cleanly truncating corrupted torn tails without state loss.
why_now: Addresses Section 66-78 durable journal consistency requirements.
scope: Framed record serialization, mid-record crash simulation, torn frame truncation, compaction replay
acceptance_criteria: Torn tail cleanly discarded; valid preceding records 100% recovered; compaction checkpoint + tail equivalence verified.
falsification_criteria: Corrupted record parsed as valid, or valid records lost on recovery.
